invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破0.089（基于ATR 0.001和更低支撑），或融资费率Z-score转正>0%（空头风险缓解），或日线趋势转牛（价格突破SMA50 0.10）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 0.089 (based on ATR 0.001 and lower support), or funding Z-score turns positive >0% (short risk eases), or daily trend turns bullish (price > SMA50 0.10).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2000（基于ATR 20.15和支撑位），或融资费率Z-score升至>50%（多头拥挤风险），或日线趋势转熊（价格跌破SMA50 2042.08）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2000 (based on ATR 20.15 and support), or funding Z-score rises >50% (long crowding risk), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 2042.08).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破83（基于ATR 0.97和支撑），或融资费率Z-score转正>0%（空头风险缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格跌破SMA50 86.04）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 83 (based on ATR 0.97 and support), or funding Z-score turns positive >0% (short risk eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 86.04).
